beat: # constancia — narration for the 5-minute demo video.
# Seven beats against a 300 s hard cap. The shot list that goes with this file
# is docs/video-script.md and the beat labels below are its rows.
# The shot list budgets ~280 s of screen time; this track is shorter on purpose.
# fit-to-audio.py keeps the moments where the screen changes at 1x and compresses
# the waiting, so the recording is fitted to THIS length, not the other way round.
# The pure-pause rows are where the viewer reads the panel: lengthen those, not
# the sentences, when a beat needs more air.
# If the track runs over the cap, cut in this order and do not improvise a new
# one on the day: (1) beat 2:00 down to 25 s by dropping its last two lines,
# (2) beat 3:40 down to 30 s by dropping the key-terms lines. Beats 0:50 and
# 2:40 are the money shots and are never the ones that get cut.
# Rows whose caption is empty are pure pauses: they buy screen time while the
# call runs. They are what keeps a beat as long as the shot list says it is.

caption: About 7 in 10 home-rehab patients quit
speak: About seven in ten patients in home rehabilitation quit their exercise plan.

caption: Not because the plan is wrong
Because nobody follows up
A physio with 40 patients cannot make 40 calls
speak: A physiotherapist with forty patients cannot make forty calls a week.

caption: So the follow-up simply does not happen
constancia phones the patient every week
speak: Constancia phones the patient every week.

caption: And remembers what she said last time
That last part is the whole product
One engine, three packs
speak: One engine, three packs.

caption: Rehab, postpartum, chronic care
The clinical content is configuration, not code
Week one. The agent asks from scratch
speak: Week one. The agent asks from scratch.

caption: Nothing on file, so it opens generically
A real number rings, off camera
speak: A real number rings, off camera.

caption: AssemblyAI transcribes her as she speaks
speak: Assembly A I transcribes her as she speaks.

caption: It asks the four rehab questions in order
The call is in Spanish. The panel stays in English
speak: The call is in Spanish. The panel stays in English.

caption: What she said is quoted as she said it
Right knee, 7 out of 10, climbing stairs
speak: Right knee, seven out of ten, climbing stairs.

caption: The exercises, three times this week
She hangs up and the extractor reads the transcript
Two facts, and every one needs a literal quote
No quote, no fact. The extractor drops it
speak: No quote, no fact. The extractor drops it.

caption: One week later. The same patient
speak: One week later. The same patient.

caption: Same number, dialled again, memory still off
The agent asks the generic protocol
Nothing about the knee. It never knew
speak: Nothing about the knee. It never knew.

caption: This is every follow-up bot you have used
Now we dial once more, with memory on
speak: Now we dial once more, with memory on.

caption: Same number, same agent. One switch
speak: Same number, same agent. One switch.

caption: It opens by asking about the knee on stairs
And it primes the recogniser with her own words
She says it is down to 4 out of 10
speak: She says it is down to four out of ten.

caption: The 7 out of 10 is not overwritten
speak: The seven out of ten is not overwritten.

caption: It is retired, and it stays in the file
This is what the physio opens on Monday
speak: This is what the physiotherapist opens on Monday.

caption: Pain down, sessions up, week over week
Every line keeps the words the patient used
And the words that primed the recogniser
speak: And the words that primed the speech recogniser.

caption: A red flag stops the call and marks it
speak: A red flag stops the call and marks it.

caption: That decision is code, never the model
Every call costs cents. The physio gets the hour back
speak: Every call costs cents. The physiotherapist gets the hour back.

caption: Sold per professional, not per patient
Built on AssemblyAI Universal-Streaming
speak: Built on Assembly A I Universal Streaming. Three real calls, transcribed live.

caption: constancia. Thanks for watching
speak: Constancia. Thanks for watching.
